title: RuyaOS runner.json, format 1
description: The file at the root of every runner's folder: a bundled copy under components/ in a .play package, or a runner the OS provides (ADR-037, docs/specs/05-play-packages.md section 6.2.1). A draft until the first release. One UTF-8 JSON object of at most 64 KiB; every key is known and none is named twice. The crate ruya-play-format (module runner) is the only parser and applies more rules than a schema can state: the size and the repeated-key rule, the full path rules of section 4.2 for entry, that each entry is a regular file in the runner's folder, that kind equals the component's type, and byte limits. tests/runner_schema.rs in that crate keeps the numbers and vocabularies below equal to its constants. A bundled copy without runner.json gets the defaults of its type; a present but invalid file refuses the package.

format.description: Major version of runner.json; a console that does not know it refuses the runner.

family.description: Versions compare only inside one family (wine, proton, proton-ge, an emulator's or engine's own name).

kind.description: The component type it serves; must equal the component's type.

version.description: At most 32 characters holding a number; versions compare as the numbers in the text (GE-Proton10-9 is 10, 9).

entry.description: The programs the runner is started through, relative to its folder: wine {wine, wineserver}, proton {proton}; none for an emulator or engine (run.command names ${component:<id>} itself).

licence.description: SPDX licence expression of the runner.

entryPath.description: A plain relative path inside the runner's folder: / separators, no leading /, no empty, . or .. parts, no backslash or colon.

httpsUrl.description: https only; no user name or password, no spaces.
